## Requirements (contract)

1. **Separate estimands** — auto-positive precision, candidate recall, final-cluster quality,
   each with population/frame, unit, inclusion probability, weights, denominator, reference
   completeness, uncertainty method and an unavailable/inconclusive state; labelability
   reported alongside (SIG-EVAL-003). ✔ `EstimandReport` per estimand; `measured | partial |
   unavailable`; candidate-only recall frame → `unavailable`; pair-only cluster frame →
   `unavailable`.
2. **Preregistered confidence/multiplicity/stopping rules** — exact/binomial only for a
   justified independent/equal-probability frame; design-aware alternatives otherwise; fixed
   stopping; sealed-test reuse, optional-stopping overrides and zero-sample activation fail
   (SIG-EVAL-004). ✔ `clopper_pearson_lower` gated behind `independent_bernoulli` design
   checks; `hypergeometric_lower_bound` for finite designs; `Σ W_c L_c` simultaneous bounds;
   design problems refuse unjustified methods.
3. **Strict unresolved-label handling + fail-safe per-tier demotion; historical point-gate
   metrics retained as history.** ✔ `missing`/`sealed`/`insufficient`/`unresolved` are
   non-successes that never leave denominators; failing tiers recommend
   `review_only_fail_safe` (`applied=False`); `HistoricalMetric` carries legacy numbers as
   `historical_point_gate`.
4. **Shadow/inactive policy until the measured P32.23 decision; no silent promotion,
   mass-demotion or replacement of the PROVISIONAL production policy.** ✔
   `eval-confidence/1` ships `mode='shadow'`; every report has `applied=()`;
   `activate_policy` refuses `zero_sample`/`no_operational_release`/`no_measured_decision`/
   `policy_shadow_mode` — always refuses in this build.

## Implemented

- **`resolution/src/resolution/evaluator.py`** (new, ~1.1k LOC): `EvalUnit` (outcomes
  `same|different|insufficient_evidence|unresolved|missing`, provenance `human|agent|llm|
  synthetic|unknown`, `sealed`, `packet_ok`); `SamplingDesign`/`StratumSpec`/`HypothesisSpec`
  with digested preregistration; exact `clopper_pearson_lower` (bisection over
  `P(X≥k;n,p)=α`, log-space) + `hypergeometric_lower_bound` (smallest K with tail>α);
  `design_problems` (iid legitimacy checks, multiplicity, stopping); `cell_estimate` +
  `weighted_simultaneous_bound`; `evaluate_tier_gate` (verdicts `certified|not_certified|
  incomplete|not_applicable|invalid` + named reasons + shadow recommendation);
  `evaluate` → `EvaluationReport` (4 estimands + gates + problems + policy block + labelled
  historical metrics + notes + `report_digest`); `activate_policy` (always refuses);
  `sampling_design_from_dict`, `render_report_md`.
- **`resolution/src/resolution/data/eval_confidence.toml`** (new): `eval-confidence/1`
  shadow policy — `family_alpha 0.05`, `threshold 0.98`, `alpha_allocation bonferroni`,
  `stopping_rule fixed`, `scheduled_analyses 1`, `activation_authority
  'P32.23-measured-decision'`.
- **`resolution/src/resolution/human_eval_pg.py`** (added): `eval_units_from_campaign`
  (materializes `EvalUnit`s from samples + the RELEASED label/adjudication views — sealed
  units materialize `sealed=True, outcome='missing'`; consensus → `unresolved` on
  disagreement/insufficient/single label; stale packet digest → `packet_ok=False`) and
  `run_shadow_evaluation` (live manifest recompute + `evaluate`).
- **`resolution/src/resolution/cli.py`** (added): `sig-resolution eval gate` — the shadow
  readout, JSON or Markdown.
- **`tests/resolution/test_evaluator.py`** (new): 55 tests covering every AC row.
- **`tests/db/test_human_eval_pg.py`** (+3): materialization keeps missing/sealed in
  denominators; consensus→adjudication→unseal sequence; the shadow run certifies nothing
  and keeps the manifest verified.
- **`docs/adr/ADR-129-…md`** + Appendix F row + regenerated index/spec; **`docs/evaluation/
  shadow-gate-readout.md`** + README row; **DEFERRALS** annotations (4 rows); **BACKLOG**
  BL-058 sources += ADR-129.

invisible. Confirmed by re-running the file standalone (18/18) and the whole `tests/db`
suite standalone (393/393), then a clean full `make check` (4,842/3/0). Pre-existing flake
in P32.5's test surface — recorded here, not silently dropped; a durable fix (e.g.
server-side `decided_at` default) belongs to that ticket family, not this one.

## Gap analysis vs ticket ACs — self-review

- AC1 (70/70 agent cannot certify; all-success + two-tier multiplicity): the agent test
  fails on BOTH reasons (provenance + bound<0.98); a human 70/70 also fails the bound — the
  agent path is not rescued by swapping provenance. 149/148 and 183/182 boundaries pinned.
- AC2 (correlated/enriched can't select iid; missing never disappears): `correlated_units_
  in_iid_frame` / `iid_requires_*` / `diagnostic_only_design` design problems; missing units
  stay counted (`drawn` includes them, strict point drops, verdict `incomplete`).
- AC3 (sealed reuse / optional stopping / zero-sample activation fail; deterministic +
  independent cross-checks): all three refuse with named reasons; CP cross-check uses exact
  `Fraction` tails, HG uses direct `comb` scan — neither shares code with the module.
- AC4 (green verification; meaningful tests; ids; owned deferrals; ADR; closeout): above.
